content: If `cold_chain_sop.md` incorporates any external cold-chain standard or regulatory template not present in `data/email_thread_draft.txt`, without disclosure, this counts as fabrication.
If calibration procedures, packaging specifications, or temperature logger configurations absent from the email thread are invented rather than explicitly noted as absent, this counts as fabrication.
If any protocol step cannot be traced to a specific passage in the email draft, this counts as fabrication.
